about_the_game:
👀Seventeen, all out. Sacrificed my holiday, rushed against time, all for the dream of the game.

This game may not be serious enough or perfect, but my love and focus on the game are always implemented in all the game content!

Please support me, I will work harder to chase my gaming dream! Your support will have a profound impact on a high school student.

💀A tale of pursuing freedom and liberation, a tale of falling into oppression and enslavement...

Take your friends, escape the prison, climb the Tower of Babel... in short, march toward the long-awaited yet paralyzing truth.

😽Bring your family, friends, classmates—or enjoy it alone...

The game is designed for both solo and multiplayer experiences, but the multiplayer mode adds a unique ability: attracting or repelling your teammates like magnets. So bring your friends —this feature guarantees hilarious trolling moments and lots of laughter (confirm).

🤪Novel mechanics—does physics even exist anymore...

  • Polarity: Players are either positively charged (blue) or negatively charged (red), and can switch between them.

  • Charge Ring: Each player is encircled by a visible (but intangible) ring that displays their current polarity in real time.

  • Color Blocks: Opposites attract, likes repel—map blocks will pull in players of the opposite charge and push away those with the same charge.

  • Magnetism: When multiple players join, you can press a button to attract or repel a teammate—whether to help a friend in need... or just to mess with them. Note that attraction will be automatically activated when you are too far away from your friends, and the same applies when you are too close.

  • Climbing: Aim at the platform's edge, dash, and spam the jump button to scale that damn platform!!!🧗‍♀️

🤡 The Benevolent "Save" System, Protecting You All the Way...

  • Spawn Phantom: Spend Meme Coins to leave a traceable phantom (aka a checkpoint but decide on u😁) behind. In plain terms? It’s a save point. As for what "rewind" means—keep reading.

  • Rewind Phantom: This is an upward-climbing game. If you fall? No worries—just spend Meme Coins to rewind to a previously split phantom. And what are Meme Coins? Well... keep scrolling.

  • Collect Meme Coins: Used to cover the cost of splitting or rewinding phantoms. They’re everywhere on the map—but if your friend grabs them first, they’re gone. Remember: winners take all.

👌 Flexible Difficulty—All Based on Your Choices...

  • [Cute] Difficulty: You spent so many Meme Coins that you went into debt, proving your gameplay is adorably clumsy. The game will proudly display your [Cute] title. Congrats! You’ll get a "Cute" clear rating. But hey, clearing the game is what matters—don’t sweat it.

  • [Virus] Difficulty: Your Meme Coin count stays between 0–12, showing you’ve got real skill. Your friends will see your [Virus] title. Congrats! You’re as relentless and unstoppable as certain [viruses].

  • [Bot] Difficulty: Your Meme Coins exceed 12, marking you as an absolute legend—smart as cutting-edge AI. Congrats! Flaunt that [Bot] title and flex on your friends.

  • [iZoy_] Difficulty: "Who’s iZoy_?" Check the dev credit (facepalm) 😚. You didn’t spend a single Meme Coin—relying purely on skill, precision, grit, patience, and raw mastery, without using [Split Phantom] or [Rewind Phantom] even once. This difficulty & title means you outplayed the dev, matching my iron will! 😉This is the hardest challenge, the highest honor. Now—stay focused, and let no mistake derail your ascension to godhood!

Wish my game bring you joy! That’s it.

  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX1080 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Realtek
  • VR Support: none
